timeline.text: I'd tap 'confirm' on a job in Telegram, and nothing happened right away.
The agent only checked every two to five minutes, so a tap could sit ignored that long.
Like pressing a crosswalk button that does nothing until the light changes anyway.
Now the button press sends a webhook straight to the agent the instant it fires.
The old pollers still run, but only as a 30-minute safety net, not the main way work gets found.
